tldr: 台股9月首日大漲820點、收46,948創近兩月新高，台積電領軍晶圓、光通訊族群齊揚。
亞幣普遍走弱，新台幣逆勢收31.633元，外資買超台股約267億元、台北股匯雙漲。
高股息ETF同慶，00713攻上62元創高、配息調升至1.25元，中信00896配息1.45元創紀錄、年化逾20%。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲820點逼近4萬7、晶圓雙雄領軍創近兩月高
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks surge 820 points to a two-month high as chip heavyweights lead
items.summary_zh: 台股9月首個交易日開高走高，終場收46,948.72點、大漲820.25點（+1.78%），創近兩月收盤新高；電子權值、光通訊、IC設計與晶圓族群齊揚，台積電、聯電尾盤大單敲進助攻，成交量略減至1.08兆元。適逢SEMICON開展、台積電與AMD齊推新一代水冷板，顯示資金對AI硬體題材買氣回溫，即便中東緊張仍壓抑全球風險情緒。
items.summary_en: The TAIEX opened firm on the first trading day of September and closed at 46,948.72, up 820.25 points (+1.78%), a near two-month closing high, as TSMC, UMC and the optical-communications, IC-design and foundry groups all rallied on the eve of SEMICON. Turnover eased to NT$1.08tn. The advance, coinciding with new water-cooling plate launches from TSMC and AMD, signals renewed appetite for AI-linked hardware even as Middle East tensions unsettle global risk assets.

items.title_zh: 台北股匯雙漲、新台幣獨強收31.633元
items.title_en: TWD closes stronger at 31.633 as foreign funds pile into Taiwan equities
items.summary_zh: 亞幣普遍承壓、美元受聯準會偏鷹與中東風險支撐，新台幣今日逆勢收31.633元、升3.3分，盤中因熱錢回流一度升破31.6元至31.59元。三大法人同步買超共561.38億元，其中外資買超約267億元，顯示AI帶動的台股買盤把資金拉回台灣，並為新台幣提供支撐。
items.summary_en: Against a weak-Asia backdrop and a firm dollar supported by a hawkish Fed and Middle East risk, the TWD bucked the trend to close up 3.3 cents at 31.633, briefly breaking 31.6 intraday on hot-money inflows. The three institutional groups bought a combined net NT$56.1bn, foreigners alone a net ~NT$26.7bn, underscoring how AI-driven equity demand is drawing capital back into Taiwan and cushioning the currency.

items.title_zh: 台灣8月車市跌破3萬台創半年低、Q4可望回溫
items.title_en: Taiwan August auto sales slip below 30,000 to a six-month low, Q4 seen recovering
items.summary_zh: 8月新車掛牌29,222台，月減24.4%、年減0.8%，創3月以來單月新低，主因農曆7月買氣淡。車商認為隨新車陸續上市、關稅議題淡化、台股反彈推升消費力，車市可望逐月回升；龍頭和泰車估9月掛牌回升至約3.4萬台。TOYOTA與LEXUS合計市占36.2%，TESLA、HONDA居3、4名。
items.summary_en: New-car registrations fell to 29,222 units in August, down 24.4% month-on-month and 0.8% year-on-year, the weakest since March, largely reflecting the Ghost Month lull. Dealers expect buying to rebound as new models launch, tariff worries fade and a stronger stock market lifts sentiment; market leader Hotai sees September registrations recovering to ~34,000. Toyota and Lexus together held 36.2% share.

items.title_zh: 遠東集團跨產業整合、亞泥攜子公司打造低碳智慧建築
items.title_en: Far Eastern Group integrates units for low-carbon smart buildings at green-building expo
items.summary_zh: 亞泥聯合亞東預拌、亞利預鑄並結合遠傳電信，首度參展「2026 Build for NextGen永續智慧建築展」，以低碳材料為起點串聯低碳混凝土、預鑄工業化營造與智慧建築營運，展現集團跨產業整合能力。此舉凸顯傳統建材業者轉向減碳與智慧營建、尋找新成長動能的趨勢。
items.summary_en: Asia Cement, together with Asia Pacific Ready-Mixed, Asia Pacific Precast and Far EasTone, made its debut at the 2026 Build for NextGen sustainable smart-building expo, showcasing a cross-industry low-carbon building solution that links low-carbon cement and concrete, industrialized precast construction and smart-building operations. The move highlights how Taiwan's traditional materials makers are pivoting toward decarbonization and digital construction to open new growth avenues.

items.title_zh: 證交所處置永冠-KY、康控-KY　9/3生效
items.title_en: TWSE penalizes two KY firms over financial-report issues; measures effective Sept 3
items.summary_zh: 證交所公布2026年第2季第一上市公司財報形式審閱結果：永冠-KY(1589)未依期限申報第2季財報，遭併案停止買賣；康控-KY(4943)因會計師出具「繼續經營能力存在重大不確定性」查核報告，併案列為變更交易方法並加採分盤集合競價，兩者均自9月3日起生效。凸顯主管機關對治理有疑慮個股加強監理。
items.summary_en: Announcing its Q2 2026 review of first-listed companies, the Taiwan Stock Exchange said Everfront-KY (1589) will have trading suspended for failing to file its Q2 report on time, while Concraft-KY (4943) is placed under altered-trading method with split-order call-auction after its auditor flagged "material uncertainty over going concern." Both measures take effect Sept 3, a reminder that regulators are tightening surveillance of governance-troubled listings.

items.title_zh: 中信00896配息1.45元創紀錄、年化逾20%
items.title_en: CTBC 00896 sets record NT$1.45 payout, ~20% annualized yield
items.summary_zh: 中國信託投信公告，中信綠能及電動車ETF(00896)最新一季每受益權單位配發1.45元，刷新成立以來紀錄。以9月1日收盤28.52元估算，單次配息率約5.08%、年化達20.3%，9月16日除息。該ETF成分股與AI供應鏈高度重疊，今年以來漲逾45%，反映除權息旺季企業獲利成長推升ETF配息與市場關注。
items.summary_en: CTBC Investments announced a quarterly distribution of NT$1.45 per unit for its Green Energy & EV ETF (00896), a record for the fund. Based on the Sept 1 close of 28.52, that is a ~5.08% single payout and ~20.3% annualized yield; ex-date is Sept 16. The 2021-launched ETF, whose green-energy/EV holdings overlap heavily with the AI supply chain, is up over 45% year-to-date, illustrating how earnings-season dividend hikes are boosting income-ETF appeal.

items.title_zh: 元大00713攻上62元創高、配息調升至1.25元、年化逾8%
items.title_en: Yuanta 00713 hits record NT$62, lifts payout to 1.25 with 8%+ annualized return
items.summary_zh: 擁近27萬受益人的元大台灣高息低波(00713)隨台股走高突破62元創歷史新高，本季配息調升至1.25元、年化報酬逾8%。今日0056、00919等9檔高股息ETF同創盤中新高；00713於震盪期間表現抗跌（7月大盤跌13.4%期間逆勢走揚），強化投資人對防禦型收益商品的需求。
items.summary_en: Yuanta Taiwan High Dividend Low Volatility ETF (00713), held by nearly 270,000 beneficiaries, climbed to an all-time high above NT$62 as the TAIEX rallied, and raised its latest quarterly distribution to NT$1.25 for an annualized return over 8%. Nine high-dividend ETFs including 0056 and 00919 set intraday highs; 00713's low-volatility tilt has helped it outperform during market swings, reinforcing demand for defensive income products.
